SELECT t_price_bidding.id , t_price_bidding.customer_id AS customerId, t_price_bidding.customer AS customer, t_price_bidding.latest_quotation AS latestQuotation, t_price_bidding.quantity AS quantity, t_price_bidding.quotation_time AS quotationTime, t_price_bidding.win_bid_status AS winBidStatus FROM t_price_bidding WHERE t_price_bidding.is_deleted = 0 AND t_price_bidding.tender_number = #{param.tenderNumber}
AND t_price_bidding.customer_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.customerId}, '%')
AND t_price_bidding.customer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.customer}, '%')
AND t_price_bidding.latest_quotation LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.latestQuotation}, '%')
AND t_price_bidding.quantity LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.quantity}, '%')
AND t_price_bidding.quotation_time LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.quotationTime}, '%')
AND t_price_bidding.win_bid_status LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.winBidStatus}, '%')
ORDER BY t_price_bidding.quotation_time DESC
